items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I got in touch with musicians in New York that I wanted to make the tour with me. My ole pal Dickie Wells on trombone, Tommy Benford, drums, and Jimmie(Slim)Rodgers, an-ex-Benny Carter pianist.

ctx.x: Lily had started to work on a concert tour of France for me, a few months before we came to Chamonix and we decided that there was no need for us to hurry back to Paris, as she could work on the coming tour where she could be away from the noise of a big city and she could concentrate better in our little chalet than she could in a hotel room. I was really surprised to discover that Lily was a woman that had a business head and not knowing anything about jazz until she met me,and after only being in France for a…

I had been a little reluctant at the beginning, thinking it could mean troubles, but Lily had convinced me that it would be interesting work for me and the publicity all over France and Europe would be very valuable. So I got in touch with musicians in New York that I wanted to make the tour with me. My ole pal Dickie Wells on trombone, Tommy Benford, drums, and Jimmie(Slim)Rodgers, an-ex-Benny Carter pianist.
